query: Our Go parser got slower after a refactor. Help me build a reliable before/after benchmark and decide whether to keep the change.
We have ten Go benchmark samples for each version. Explain the benchstat output, including the rows marked ~.
Go pprof shows runtime.mallocgc and GC dominating CPU. Find a measured optimization path and verify the result.
I am preparing a release of our Go service. Review this proposed sync.Pool optimization for performance and tell me what evidence would justify it.
Our Go API has high p99 latency and low CPU. Help investigate the time spent waiting before we tune allocations.
Help set up a CI check that compares Go benchmark regressions against the PR base without trusting noisy single runs.
We suspect lock contention in our Go worker service. Interpret the mutex profile and execution trace and propose how to validate a fix.
Can we reduce Go heap usage? I have before and after inuse_space profiles under the same load and want to distinguish retention from churn.
The deployment checklist is nearly done. One remaining item: compare Go builds with and without PGO using our representative CPU profile.
For this Go hot path, compare cache reuse and preallocation candidates using repeatable measurements, correctness checks, and an honest performance conclusion.
Explain what a Go slice is and how len differs from cap. I do not need performance tuning.
Our Go program panics on a nil pointer during startup. Help identify the bug from this stack trace.
Add OpenTelemetry trace propagation to this Go HTTP handler. This is routine instrumentation setup, not a latency investigation.
Set up a basic Prometheus metrics endpoint in a new Go service and show request and error counters.
Write unit tests for this Go parser covering malformed JSON and missing required fields. Keep its implementation unchanged.
Explain the syntax of Go channels and select for a beginner; use a tiny runnable example.
Our Go service cannot connect to Postgres because the password is wrong. Explain how to fix the connection configuration.
Update the Go module path after we renamed the repository. No runtime behavior or optimization changes are needed.
Help me write release notes for this Go library. Mention the already verified performance improvement of 15% exactly as supplied; no new analysis.
I have a slow Python loop and want to benchmark and optimize it. This repository contains no Go code.
Write the performance review conclusion for our Go encoder PR. Benchmarks improved by 8%, allocations stayed flat, tests pass, and no production load test exists yet.
Our Go parsing change is faster but uses more memory. Help me decide whether the evidence justifies approval and write the reviewer handoff.
Copy this already-approved Go benchmark result verbatim into the release notes: Parse is 15% faster. Do not assess or reinterpret it.
Write a code review conclusion for a Go documentation-only PR that fixes a broken benchmark tutorial link. There are no code or performance changes.
this go function is kinda slow, can you make it faster?
Our Go service runs in a 2 GiB container. Should we set GOMEMLIMIT, and to what?
go build -gcflags=-m says this struct escapes to the heap in my hot loop. Is that why allocs/op went up?
We keep a single http.Client but see lots of new TLS handshakes under load in Go. Should we tune the transport's connection pool?
A Go unit test started failing after last week's commits. Help me find which commit broke it.
Our Go worker hangs forever after a deploy and goroutine dumps show it blocked on a channel. What is wrong?
Should I protect this shared Go counter with a mutex or use a channel?
Configure pgx pool settings so our Go service stops returning connection errors when the database restarts.
Add Prometheus alerts for p99 latency SLO breaches to our Go service's dashboards.
